chunks: I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
So among you is a disbeliever, and among you is a believer.
So he عليه السلام said: Allah knew their faith through our wilayah, and their disbelief in it, on the day He took the covenant from them in the loins of Ādam عليه السلام while they were ذرّ.

key_terms.إِيمَانَهُمْ: their faith, identified in relation to wilayah
key_terms.بِوَلَايَتِنَا: through our wilayah; allegiance and authority connected to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.ذَرٌّ: minute particles, referring to humankind in the pre-temporal covenant
key_terms.صُلْبِ آدَمَ: the loins of Ādam عليه السلام, referring to the primordial origin of humanity
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the divine statement being asked about

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explain the verse 'among you is a disbeliever and among you is a believer'?
ai.summary: This narration explains the verse by linking belief and disbelief to acceptance or rejection of the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It situates this recognition in the primordial covenant taken from the descendants of Ādam عليه السلام when they were ذرّ.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Husayn Bin Nuaym Al Sahhaf who said, 
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[64:2] He it is Who Created you, so among you is an unbeliever and among you is a Believer.

So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Recognised their Eman by ourasws Wilayah and their disbelief in it on the day Heazwj Took the Covenant upon them in ‘صُلْبِ’ the forehead of Adamas, and they were particles’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from al-Hassan ibn Nu‘aym al-Sahhaf who has said the following. “I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious.
“. .some of you have accepted the faith and some of you have not.. .” [64:2]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “On the day that Allah made all the offspring of Adam to make a covenant with Him when they were just small particles He made faith our Wilaya, (Leadership with Divine Authority) the standard for faith and disbelief.”
